intro: The Phial of Scrying is an enchanted vessel provided by the ancient of lore Onu in Darkshore. When used, it manifests a scrying bowl that allows distant communion across the corrupted woodlands.

p: Entrusted to scouts investigating deep within Darkshore, the Phial of Scrying contains mystical waters that conjures a temporary scrying bowl upon the earth. This tool enables long-distance divination, allowing travelers venturing into perilous reaches like the Master's Glaive to commune directly with Onu without immediately journeying back to his grove.
